name: Corner Time
soft_passes: #1 designed for the squircle but ships a baked-in mask (alpha-0 corners) + baked drop shadow — an iOS/web-render composite, not unmasked Icon Composer layers
#2 no centred glyph to grid (full-bleed field); mark is top-heavy and right-weighted, optical mass sits high
#4 dark-band-on-light-body gestalt survives at 16px, but the 09:41 digits (the actual subject) smear illegibly
failures: #3 silhouette: solid-black fill = featureless squircle; subject carried only by internal light/dark contrast, no shape identity
#10 variant robustness: fixed greyscale render, no layer variants; hard black band + white numerals over silver gives tinted/clear/dark modes nothing to adapt
#12 no-text: baked literal numerals '09:41' plus a UI/menu-bar depiction — both explicit no-text-check violations

palette.background: ramp #EAEAEA->#D2D2D2 (silver body, vertical top-light; flat #E0E0E0 left-to-right)

light_model: Soft top-down; subtle vertical luminance ramp on the silver body (~#EAEAEA under the bar -> ~#D2D2D2 at base), flat black header band, no specular/refraction/translucency; short baked drop shadow under the squircle (render composite).
devices: self-referential product depiction (the icon IS the app's on-screen output)
full-bleed field (art bleeds to mask edge; whole squircle = a screen)
corner-anchored clock (numerals in the top-right corner, echoing the app name)
rhymes_hint: austere greyscale utility icons and literal-UI-depiction marks (menu-bar tools, screenshot/display utilities); Swiss-reductive near-white/near-black with no hue, Big-Sur-era squircle
notes: Resolution: 460x460 downscaled web render, not a 1024 master — fine detail (specular, edge treatment, exact ramp endpoints) unverifiable; simple enough that this doesn't affect the read. PNG is a composited render: alpha-0 corners = baked squircle mask, plus a baked drop shadow, so mask-discipline and Liquid-Glass layer/variant readiness cannot be judged from source layers. Pure greyscale, zero accent. Text '09:41' is Apple's canonical demo time, baked in. Subject communication is total and literal (icon depicts the exact app output). Icon<->brand palette incoherent: cover.png is Sonoma-blue + cyan wordmark; the icon carries none of that blue. Single app, no promotions — 'self-referential UI depiction' is a candidate device to test against future monochrome-utility icons.
